Nini-4.cube: Nini, Danish North Sea: NODAB-97 3D final migration, box around Nini-4

ext.about: Danish well of 2002 on the Nini West oil field, studied as a CO2 store in Project Greensand. Shown because it has what the open Norwegian wells in this app lack together: a shear sonic log, a vertical seismic profile and smectite measured on samples of the Eocene clay (the Horda Formation, which GEUS describes as greenish grey to greyish green mudstone). Vertical to within 13 m; measured depth and vertical depth differ by at most 0.2 m.
ext.logs: Free GEUS well package NINI-4 (merged wireline logs), GEUS terms for free Danish subsurface data
